title: Riverbend Term Schedule by Balance for Paused Patient Payment Plans
content:
The longest paused schedule of a **Patient Payment Plan** may run past the tier's maximum term only as far as the balance ceiling of the paused schedule allows, following Riverbend's term schedule by balance.

**Balance read.** The balance is read from the plan's own ledger as the amounts enrolled less the installments paid (the down payment included) and the reductions booked.

**Rule.** The balance ceiling is 60 installments when that balance is at least 10000.00 and 48 installments when it is at least 3000.00, the first of these that applies, each only on tiers whose maximum term is shorter; otherwise the balance ceiling is the tier's maximum term.

| Tier | Tier maximum term | Ledger balance at least 10000.00 | At least 3000.00 but below 10000.00 | Below 3000.00 |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Riverbend Short-Term Payment Plan | 6 | 60 | 48 | 6 |
| Riverbend Standard Payment Plan | 12 | 60 | 48 | 12 |
| Riverbend Extended Payment Plan | 24 | 60 | 48 | 24 |
| Riverbend Long-Term Payment Plan | 36 | 60 | 48 | 36 |
| Riverbend Assistance-Linked Payment Plan | 48 | 60 | 48 | 48 |
| Riverbend Hardship Payment Plan | 60 | 60 | 60 | 60 |

**Hypothetical.** Enrolled 12000.00, installments paid 1500.00, reductions 600.00: the ledger balance is 9900.00, below 10000.00 and at least 3000.00, so on a tier with a 36-installment maximum term the balance ceiling is 48. With reductions of 0.00 the balance would be 10500.00 and the ceiling 60.
